notes:
=== CONCEPT ===
mssqlclient.py from Impacket connects to MSSQL using Windows authentication (NTLM/Kerberos) via -windows-auth flag. Essential in domain environments where SQL auth may be disabled. Provides interactive T-SQL prompt.

=== CHAINING ===
Discover MSSQL (nmap-mssql-scan) → enumerate instance (msf mssql_ping) → connect with domain credentials → enumerate databases → check xp_cmdshell → OS command execution if enabled.

=== KEY QUERIES ===
select name from sys.databases → enumerate all databases
select name from master.dbo.sysdatabases → alternate
EXEC xp_cmdshell 'whoami' → OS command execution (if enabled)
EXEC sp_configure 'xp_cmdshell', 1 → enable if SA privileges available

=== SA ACCOUNT ===
sa (system administrator) account with blank/weak password is common. Full DBA rights → enable xp_cmdshell → OS command execution as SQL service account.
